course.name: Warrior Trading
course.tagline: A day trading education platform founded by Ross Cameron in 2012, focused on small-cap momentum trading.
course.about: Warrior Trading is a day trading education company founded by Ross Cameron in 2012. It teaches small-cap momentum strategies — including low-float stocks with a catalyst, gap-and-go entries, and micro pullbacks — through live-streamed trading sessions where students watch Ross and other traders make real-time decisions.

_notes.source: One of the most widely recognized day trading education brands, added for directory credibility rather than affiliate revenue — no affiliate relationship exists. Warriortrading.com returned 403 Forbidden to direct fetch, so about/curriculum/formats came from WebSearch results (multiple independent review sites agreeing on the same figures) rather than the primary site directly; pricing cross-confirmed across several sources. Trustpilot (4.8/5, 2,773 reviews, Excellent) confirmed directly. Logo is the provider's own favicon.
